A giant storm costume that slowly shrinked would cause way too much lag. So in this case I made the storm a single eedge of it and it just "follows" the player around out by a certain distance, preventing the player from passing through it.
The StormRadius is constantly decreasing.

First it decides its center point, and then it figures out the direction from the storm center to the player's position. This will be the angle the storm has closest to the player. Once it has its direction, it sets its x and y position based on the storm radius, and the sine and cosine of the direction

x02{su].b%,Y0fIHim{^.text:
The enemies are just awesome. Here's how they work:

- Every enemy has its enemy ID # (in _enemy#)
- They update their positions constantly in the lists EnemyX, EnemyY and EnemyHealth

- Each enemy has its own inventory, a short list (_EnemyInventory) of items it's picked up. As the enemy walks around it checks for nearby items and picks them up at random (no more than 4) (it can also chop down trees and walls if it has an axe- if it doesn't it tries to switch to it). It can also drop items at random.
When the enemy dies, it drops the items in its inventory.

- The "Find Target" block below decides which enemy, item or location it wants to target. It can check the distances to coordinates and the angle it needs to point there.
- If it has a gun in its inventory, it checks for nearby enemies.
   - If there are enemies nearby, it hovers around the target, running towards either the enemy or a random l . 
      location. The enemy's gun is almost always out at this point.
   - If there are no enemies nearby,
       - If the enemy's inventory is full, it targets the center of the storm (safe zone)
       - If the enemy has free space, it targets the closest item.
- If it doesn't have a gun in its inventory, it scans for the nearest gun and goes to pick it up.

- It uses the items (it can shoot with different guns, chop down trees, build and eat)
- It checks if it's gotten hit (Hit list has been updated by the bullets)
- Finally it updates all costumes/effects at the end
